description: The reference decomposition case for this folder: three records, read and printed in one clean pass, with the whole 150-byte layout written out below so a reviewer can verify every field, offset and width against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy BY EYE, without running anything. Where case03 proves one record and case05 a mid-volume slice, this case exists to be the folder's readable map of the record itself. WHAT THE CLASS NAME GETS WRONG: the unit under test is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob - an Account-named class in the account package - yet CBACT02C computes no balance and never touches the account file. It reads the CARD file. app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:29-33 is SELECT CARDFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO CARDFILE, ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, RECORD KEY IS FD-CARD-NUM; :37-40 is an FD of FD-CARD-NUM X(16) plus FD-CARD-DATA X(134) = 150; and :45 is COPY CVACT02Y. AAP rule R1 governs - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and the divergence is catalogued in the register at AAP 0.8.4. A reviewer who trusts the class name will look for the wrong file and the wrong arithmetic. THE RUN, once through app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:70-87. :71 displays the 38-character start banner. :72 performs 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, whose OPEN INPUT at :120 reports '00', so :121 takes its first arm and :126-127 CONTINUE. The PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' at :74-81 then runs three full iterations: each READs at :93, lands on the CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' arm at :94, and :78 displays CARD-RECORD - the 01 group item, so the whole 150-byte area including its FILLER. :96 is a COMMENT and there is no 1100-DISPLAY paragraph, so one record yields exactly ONE line and no separator, header or blank line is emitted between images. The fourth READ reports '10', :99 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, :107 finds the 88-level APPL-EOF true and :108 moves 'Y' into END-OF-FILE, so the loop ends without a fourth display. 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE reports '00' at :139, :140 SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT leaves zero, :85 displays the 36-character end banner, and GOBACK at :87 leaves RETURN-CODE 0. In repository terms the status sequence is: startBrowse '00', then readNext '00' three times, then readNext '10', then endBrowse '00' (gate G47). The job is driven at tasklet/step level, with no JobLauncher and no HTTP anywhere in the path (gate G51). MESSAGE ARITHMETIC: 1 start banner + 3 record images + 1 end banner = 5 ordered DISPLAY_LINE entries, of widths 38, 150, 150, 150 and 36. RECORD GEOMETRY, taken mechanically from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy (01 CARD-RECORD, RECLN 150), one-based offsets with cumulative ends: CARD-NUM PIC X(16) at 1-16, width 16, cumulative 16 - and also the RECORD KEY; CARD-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at 17-27, width 11, cumulative 27; CARD-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) at 28-30, width 3, cumulative 30; CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME PIC X(50) at 31-80, width 50, cumulative 80; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE PIC X(10) at 81-90, width 10, cumulative 90; CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS PIC X(01) at 91, width 1, cumulative 91; FILLER PIC X(59) at 92-150, width 59, cumulative 150. 16+11+3+50+10+1+59 = 150, so every image ends in 59 spaces; those spaces are significant and must not be trimmed (gates G19 and G21). THE MISSPELLING IS THE CONTRACT: the copybook spells the date field CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE, missing the second T, exactly as CVACT01Y spells its own ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE. It is written verbatim here and is never silently corrected to CARD-EXPIRATION-DATE, because field-for-field diffing keys on the name (AAP implicit requirement I1). NO SIGN OVERPUNCH EXISTS IN THIS RECORD: CVACT02Y declares no COMP-3, no PACKED-DECIMAL and no S9 anywhere - verified by search - so both numeric spans, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) and CARD-CVV-CD 9(03), are UNSIGNED zoned DISPLAY. That is what distinguishes carddata from acctdata, tcatbal and dailytran, whose signed money fields close on a zoned overpunch byte such as '{' for a positive digit zero. There is no sign byte to model here, and no span of this record may be decoded as though there were. THE THREE ROWS, DECOMPOSED at those offsets - fixture rows 0, 1 and 2 of carddata.txt, which are already in ascending RECORD KEY order as a KSDS browse delivers them. Row 1: CARD-NUM 0500024453765740, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000050, CARD-CVV-CD 747, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Aniya Von' followed by 41 spaces to fill X(50), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2023-03-09, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. Row 2: CARD-NUM 0683586198171516, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000027, CARD-CVV-CD 567, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Ward Jones' followed by 40 spaces, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2025-07-13, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. Row 3: CARD-NUM 0923877193247330, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000002, CARD-CVV-CD 028, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Enrico Rosenbaum' followed by 34 spaces, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2024-08-11, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, FILLER 59 spaces. 0500024453765740 < 0683586198171516 < 0923877193247330, so the displayed order is the browse order. WHY ROW 3 IS IN THIS CASE AT ALL: its CARD-CVV-CD is 028, a LEADING-ZERO zoned value. It is carried as the three characters 0, 2, 8 and never as the integer 28, which is the standing proof that a PIC 9(n) span is emitted zero-filled to its declared width rather than as a number that has lost its leading zeros. Row 3's CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000002 makes the same point across eleven characters. NOTHING IS WRITTEN: expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty, and that emptiness is a positive assertion rather than an absence of interest - :120 opens the file INPUT and the program contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE at all, its only output being SYSOUT at app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:27. No normalisation is declared because carddata.txt rows are already the full 150 bytes CVACT02Y declares, so neither recorded fixture-to-copybook deviation applies here. WIRING: app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:22 is a bare //STEP05 EXEC PGM=CBACT02C with no PARM and CBACT02C has no LINKAGE SECTION to receive one into, so jobParameters is empty; its single //CARDFILE DD at :25-26 is the only dataset, addressed here solely by the CARDFILE binding key that application.yml resolves at record length 150, so no dataset-name literal appears anywhere in this file (gate G46). ENCODING is US-ASCII, named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. PROVENANCE: every expected value in this file is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy for each offset and width, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl for the step and DD contract, and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt for the three seeded rows. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from a live COBOL execution. AAP 0.7.6 proves such a run impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler disabled, subprogram linkage that cannot be made executable, a copybook that will not parse, no Language Environment CEE services, no CICS emulator alongside three absent IBM copybooks, EBCDIC fixtures needing binary handling, and no alternative compiler installable - and the substitution of provenance is recorded as risk R-A. Only the provenance changes; the 20 cases, the field-for-field diff and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand. GATES PINNED HERE: G15 (one of the twenty cases for this program), G18 (its diff count must be zero), G19 and G21 (the 150-byte width and the space-filled FILLER), G47 (the four file-status outcomes in sequence), G51 (asserted below the HTTP and JobLauncher layers) and G46 (binding key, never a DSNAME). Not applicable: G30 and G32, since CBACT02C contains no GO TO; G33, since it declares no OCCURS; G16 and both right-pad normalisations, since carddata.txt needs neither; and G20 and G24 through G28, G35, G37 through G43, since this program writes no record, performs no arithmetic beyond its own status bookkeeping, raises no abend on this path and drives no screen. Three records in, five lines out, RETURN-CODE 0.
